E-invoicing · EN 16931 · ViDA

EU E-Invoicing Readiness Kit: one plan for every mandate.

Belgium and Croatia switched in 2026, France and Poland are rolling out, Germany, Spain and the Netherlands follow, and ViDA arrives in 2030. This kit shows which mandates apply to you and gets your business ready.

Notion template
Price
€29.99
Formats
Notion template
Languages
EU edition in English; country editions for DE/AT, NL, ES and HR
Access
Instantly after purchase, one-time payment

EN 16931 · Peppol · ViDA

What's in the kit

  • Mandate Tracker — 18 mandates (BE, HR, DE, FR, PL, ES, IT, NL, EU ViDA) with live countdowns and official sources
  • Readiness Plan — 15 tasks across 7 workstreams, linked to each mandate
  • Invoice Data Checklist — the 30 core EN 16931 fields, so your invoices aren't rejected
  • Provider Comparison — compare software and access points on formats, countries and price
  • Partner Directory — your customers' and suppliers' e-invoice addresses and readiness
  • Setup guide with country quick notes and a partner announcement email
  • Example rows, an FAQ and a key-dates table

The rules it covers

  • National mandates

    Member states are introducing B2B e-invoicing one by one, each with its own dates, formats and platforms. The mandate tracker keeps them in one place, with official sources.

  • EN 16931

    The European standard for the core content of an e-invoice. Invoices that miss required fields can be rejected by the recipient's system.

  • ViDA

    VAT in the Digital Age makes e-invoicing and digital reporting the rule for intra-EU B2B transactions from 2030.

Made for

  • Small and mid-sized businesses trading across borders
  • Finance teams and bookkeepers
  • Accounting firms advising clients
  • Businesses invoicing customers in several EU countries

Notion template

This kit is currently available as a Notion template. The free Notion plan is enough.

Questions about this kit

Which countries does the kit cover?
Belgium, Croatia, Germany, France, Poland, Spain, Italy, the Netherlands and EU ViDA: 18 mandates in total, each with its dates and an official source. Content verified on 29 October 2026.
Do I need new software?
Often, but not always. The provider comparison helps you check whether your current software supports the formats you need, or which provider or access point to choose.
Is there a Word or Excel edition?
Not yet. This kit is currently available as a Notion template only. The free Notion plan is enough: after purchase you click “Duplicate” and the kit is copied into your own workspace.
